timing: fields selected after source-only schema, before new diet outcome calculation
primary_diet_sample: EUPHAUSIA_SUPERBA_MASS_g/TOTAL_MASS_g; total>0 and both finite, all values from same individual original RECORD_ID/date
primary_diet_annual: mean equal-weighted per recorded stomach sample fraction; at least 3 samples per species season
primary_stage: source-preserved median recorded fledglings/pairs at species×season, not actual survival
season_assignment: DATE month 7–12 -> same year; 1–6 -> previous year; strict ISO or DD/MM/YYYY; no unknown replacement
exposure_order: store each diet sample min/max and each stage fledgling-date min/max; only 'all diets before all fledgling' supports strict sequence; overlapping/missing dates not forward exposures
exploratory_associations: species-specific Pearson same-season and year-to-year first differences, plus paired species differences when same season observed
inference: descriptive only, no selected p-value, no transfer to climate or forecast
no_pooling: no treating multiple stomachs as independent ecosystem-years; Gentoo aggregate stage and other species colony medians not identical grain
